lines: Browns at Steelers is the division game that matters, both 5-2, PIT -3.5 with a 39.5 total. Mon 2 Nov, 2:00 am Perth.
Minnesota is 6-0 and goes to Detroit as a 3-point dog, total 46.5. Lions are 4-2 after beating Green Bay 20-17.
Kansas City at Denver, KC -1.5, total 40.5. The Chiefs are 5-1 but just got held to 3 in Seattle. Broncos are 5-2.
Baltimore at Buffalo, BUF -3, total 54.5. The Ravens are 4-3 on an L2 and were beaten 35-13 at home by Cincinnati.
Chargers are 0-6 and travel to the Rams as 6.5-point dogs. Jacksonville, 4-2, is -10 over Indianapolis in Jacksonville showers.
Eagles are 2-5 after losing 38-21 to Dallas, and they are 5.5-point dogs at 1-4-1 Washington on Sunday night.

pregame.matchup_read: Cincinnati hosts Tennessee at Paycor, Mon 2 Nov, 2:00 am Perth, cloudy and 20C. Bengals are 4-2 and laid 35 on Baltimore. Titans are 1-6. The line is CIN -12.5 with a total of 46.5.
storylines: ESPN's preview frames it simply: Burrow and the Bengals go into November healthy and with momentum, hosting a struggling Titans side.
Tennessee traded its best player. ESPN reports GM Mike Borgonzi sent Jeffery Simmons to Chicago after an offer he could not refuse.
Cincinnati sits third in the AFC North at 4-2 behind Cleveland and Pittsburgh at 5-2, but leads the division in point differential at +41.
Last week Burrow went 22/30 for 292 and 4 TD in Baltimore, with the Bengals 5-for-5 in the red zone.
watch_for: Red zone finishing. Cincinnati converted all five trips in Baltimore. Against a 1-6 team, that is how -12.5 gets covered early.
Tee Higgins after 6 rec, 148 yds, 1 TD. Baltimore could not handle him and Chase still got 5 for 62 and a score.
The run game. Chase Brown had 11 for 39 and the team averaged 3.7 a carry. A 12.5-point favourite usually needs to close games on the ground.
pregame.the_call: Bengals win and cover. Tennessee just lost 27-24 at home to Cleveland, and Cincinnati is scoring 7.0 yards a play with zero turnovers last week. Take the under too at 46.5 if Cincy runs clock.

postgame.what_decided_it: Red zone math and the second half. Cincinnati went 5-5 in the red zone, Baltimore 0-3. Yards were nearly even, 357 to 359, but the Bengals scored every trip and took no turnovers.
standouts: Joe Burrow: 22/30, 292 yds, 4 TD, 0 INT. Efficient, 9.2 yards per pass attempt as a team.
Tee Higgins: 6 rec, 148 yds, 1 TD. Ja'Marr Chase added 5 rec, 62 yds and a score.
Defense: 4 sacks for 22 yards and a pick of Tyler Huntley, who still went 23/34 for 298.
postgame.division_meaning: Cleveland and Pittsburgh sit 5-2, Cincinnati 4-2 on a W2 streak with a plus-41 point differential, best in the division. Baltimore drops to 4-3 and L2.
postgame.the_take: Point differential says the Bengals are the best team in this division even from third place. ESPN credits a fiery Chase halftime speech for the comeback; the 5-5 red zone trip chart says scheme held up too.
